highlights.languageTitle: How Do You Learn the Language Here?
languageParagraphs: Instead of learning from a textbook, you learn through real conversations, shared meals, cultural exchange, and meeting people from around the world.
You hear Spanish and English naturally around the table.
You practise the language while sharing stories, laughing together, and discovering different cultures.
Whether you're fluent, just starting, or somewhere in between, SpeakEasy is designed to make language feel natural, social, and enjoyable.

items.question: What is included in the experience?
items.answer: Every experience includes a guided visit to Mercado Central, all ingredients, cooking instruction, a full meal with wine, and a recipe booklet to take home.

items.question: Do I need any cooking experience?
items.answer: Not at all! Our experiences are designed for all skill levels. Our chefs guide you through every step in a fun, relaxed environment.

items.question: What languages are the classes offered in?
items.answer: All classes are offered in English and Spanish. Private groups can request other languages with advance notice.

items.question: Can you accommodate dietary restrictions?
items.answer: Yes! We offer vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and other dietary options. Please let us know when booking.

items.question: What is the cancellation policy?
items.answer: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the experience. Cancellations within 48 hours are eligible for a 50% refund or rescheduling.

items.question: How many people are in each group?
items.answer: Our standard groups have a maximum of 12 people to ensure a personal, hands-on experience. Private groups can be arranged for larger parties.

story.title: The Story Behind SpeakEasy Valencia
story.subtitle: Born from Passion
story.content:
SpeakEasy Valencia was created by Gene, who has spent more than 40 years in Valencia and has dedicated much of his life to teaching languages and bringing people together through culture and conversation.

Over the years, he saw that people learn languages best not through pressure or memorisation, but through real human experiences - shared meals, storytelling, music, laughter, and meaningful conversations around the table.

That idea became the foundation of SpeakEasy Valencia: a place where people can experience Spanish naturally while feeling part of the warmth, rhythm, and culture of Mediterranean life.

intro.title: More Than a Cooking Class
intro.subtitle: An immersive cultural experience
paragraphs: Valencia is the birthplace of SpeakEasy — and there's no better way to connect with this city's soul than by cooking its most iconic dish over an open fire.
From hand-picking the freshest ingredients at local markets to mastering the art of socarrat, this is an experience that engages all your senses.
Whether you choose our urban art-gallery setting or a countryside villa, you'll leave with unforgettable memories, new skills, and a full heart.

description.title: About This Experience
paragraphs: Step into the heart of Valencian culture with our signature SpeakEasy experience. This isn't just a cooking class — it's an immersive journey through the flavors, traditions, and soul of Spain's most famous dish.

Your adventure begins at the legendary Mercado Central, where you'll wander through centuries-old stalls bursting with fresh seafood, vibrant vegetables, and aromatic spices. Your expert chef guides you as you select the perfect ingredients.

Back at our stunning venue, you'll master the art of SpeakEasy over traditional wood fire. Learn the techniques passed down through generations — the perfect sofrito, the ideal rice-to-broth ratio, and the coveted socarrat.
